adapter.placement: existing 144 MASt3R decoder attention linear modules
adapter.initialization: existing random A and zero B

optimization.forward_strategy: graph-free output collection followed by exact same-state output-adjoint replay
optimization.fold_schedule: alternate support and query roles by macro-step parity
optimization.P1_full_step: mean existing objective over schedule(20), reuse 20 unique pair outputs, original depth plus 0.1 consistency and full adaptation-packet per-pair gauges
optimization.final_matching: fresh float32 matching from each arm

geometric_layer.raw_depth_tensor: canon[..., 2] from pinned canonical_view, with frozen pretrained fusion confidences; canon2 is a ratio and is not used as depth
geometric_layer.camera_input: supplied metric camera poses and intrinsics
geometric_layer.sensor_normalizer: 0.02 times support-only median measured depth per target
geometric_layer.graph_normalizer: 0.02 times geometric mean of the two views' support-only median measured depths
geometric_layer.sensor_weights: initial support residual Huber weights, transition 1, frozen per spatial fold
geometric_layer.graph_weights: frozen initial pretrained matching confidence and initial Huber weights
geometric_layer.match_robust_weight: min(1, 1 / normalized_initial_3D_residual_norm), shared by the three coordinate rows
geometric_layer.match_confidence: geometric mean of positive pretrained fused endpoint confidences, normalized by its edge mean
geometric_layer.query_row_factor: 1 / (sensor_normalizer * sqrt(5 * query_count_view)); no query-derived robust weights
geometric_layer.ridge_strength: 0.001 times trace(A_D0.T @ A_D0)/5 from the initial sensor-only matrix, identical across arms and frozen per spatial fold
geometric_layer.ridge_center: ones after fixed support-only initial metric normalization
geometric_layer.support_normalization: pretrained per-view median measured/predicted ratio using support pixels
geometric_layer.condition_diagnostics: unregularized singular values, per-view sensor coverage, graph connected components
geometric_layer.invalid_scale_action: retain and report failure; redesign positive-scale solver before full screen
geometric_layer.native_alignment_relation: five-scale surrogate; final native alignment separately evaluated

arms.objective: existing D depth and same-reference consistency

disjoint query depth after support and graph calibration

initial_screen.primary_metric: absolute held-source axial error, equal target then scene weights
initial_screen.primary_endpoint: native KDP followed by common final five-scale refinement
initial_screen.secondary_endpoint: native KDP before final five-scale refinement
initial_screen.solver_gradient_comparator: P3 vs P2 and P4 vs P5
initial_screen.final_calibration_observations: all allowed adaptation observations with a fresh initial metric gauge and fixed normalizers
initial_screen.native_endpoint: existing KDP 300/300, pose weight 0.01, identical permitted input observations for all arms including P0
initial_screen.final_camera_convention: native optimized K and rotations; global g0=median of measured/native depth ratios over permitted adaptation packet; metric centers g0*(C_native-C0_native) and depths g0*z_native
initial_screen.final_graph: fresh native matches frozen during final five-scale solve
initial_screen.normalizer_interpretation: engineering residual scales, no calibrated covariance claim

conditional_ablations: correlated source calibration covariance versus diagonal covariance and scalar robust weighting
